title: PackageDetailsLeaf
description: A catalog leaf representing a snapshot of package metadata. Produced when a package is pushed, relisted, unlisted, deprecated, undeprecated, reflowed, or has its vulnerability status updated.

@type.description: The type(s) of the catalog item, including PackageDetails.

catalog:commitId.description: A commit ID associated with this catalog item.

catalog:commitTimeStamp.description: The commit timestamp of this catalog item.

version.description: The full version string after normalization.

published.description: The time when the package was last listed. Set to year 1900 on nuget.org when unlisted.

created.description: A timestamp of when the package was first created on the source.

dependencyGroups.description: The dependencies grouped by target framework.

iconUrl.description: The URL to the package icon.

isPrerelease.description: Whether the package version is a prerelease.

licenseUrl.description: The URL to the package license.

minClientVersion.description: The minimum NuGet client version required.

packageHash.description: The hash of the package encoded using standard base 64.

packageHashAlgorithm.description: The hashing algorithm used. Typically SHA512 on nuget.org.

packageSize.description: The size of the package .nupkg in bytes.

packageTypes.description: The package types specified by the author.

projectUrl.description: The URL to the project page.

releaseNotes.description: Release notes for this package version.

requireLicenseAgreement.description: Whether the package requires license acceptance.

verbatimVersion.description: The version string as originally found in the .nuspec.

vulnerabilities.description: Security vulnerabilities associated with this version.
